purpose: Define `Lens` as a named reusable read/projection definition over one or more canonical source Topics, Domains, Projects, schemas or runtime sources.

value.name: Lens
value.identity_rule: Each Lens has an explicit stable canonical identity.
value.source_rule: Lens references exact canonical source identities or Topics.
value.projection_rule: Lens defines selection, transformation, grouping, comparison and visualization semantics only.
value.ownership_rule: Lens never becomes owner of the source semantics it observes.
value.multi_source_rule: A Lens may compose multiple source Topics/surfaces with explicit bindings.
value.parameter_rule: Lens parameters/controls are explicit and validated.
value.authority_rule: Lens execution obeys source visibility/authorization and cannot broaden it.
value.output_rule: Lens output is a derived projection unless explicitly persisted through a separate canonical operation.
